design: semi-parametric: windows drawn from effect-free ORIGINAL-WT2 MoE paired-effect articles (keeps real window/article covariance), arranged into clusters with the exact fresh_article sizes [5, 5, 1, 8, 3, 3, 5, 2, 2, 1]; 'effect' adds true within-seed effects with variance = original V_corr and the original ranking
interpretation: frac_null_p_below_05 under 'null' = size of the common-effect null test with 10 article clusters; under 'effect' = power to detect the original-magnitude effect
